cpu_policy: one logical CPU from an Intel Core-type P-core; explicit override allowed and recorded
claim_boundary: No cross-host performance claim is complete until a target-generated archive passes the local importer.
deployment_boundary: Ubuntu and Docker are not bundled or installed. The target must already run Ubuntu 20.04 x86_64; all compiler sources, build prerequisites, Python wheels and tool bootstrap archives are bundled for offline installation.
